## Security verdict: PASS WITH NOTES

PR #214, final round 2, at **b1461b876ddf13894d2635d85af46b958c5ea63e**. Reviewed the nine-file delta from `6c831f4eb1f293446ecd81cb1ec506849034dc68` and directly relevant final source under C33/C34. No security vulnerability identified.

| Delta | Evidence and disposition |
|---|---|
| F001 full-read refresh | Both claimed-batch and pending reads refresh returned copies, without updating stored bodies (`crates/daemon/src/http/fyi.rs:130-184`). Backing reads remain recipient-bound, parameterized SELECTs (`crates/store/src/queue.rs:1353-1370`; `store/src/orchestration.rs:517-532`). The six-FYI digest/full-read regression ran in CI. |
| F002 ordinary queued handover | Shared inbox/native/extension claim handling adds the PA line before final observation revalidation and returning the claim (`delivery/mod.rs:2055-2089`). The pane worker adds it before routing/typing (`pointer/worker.rs:346-352,599-621`). The queued change-before-consumption regression ran in CI. Direct typed/socket attempts use their admission-time line; the deferred typed exception is named below. |
| Retry preservation | The worker keeps changed noted bodies by job ID for retries, bounded to 64 jobs (`pointer/worker.rs:120-130,186-210`). This preserves the attempted text for leftover recognition; it is not a restart-persistent snapshot guarantee. |
| N001 message budget | The PA line is capped at 300 UTF-8 bytes; the stall builder reserves that plus its separator within 2,048 bytes (`crates/core/src/fyi_watch.rs:27-38,107-130,184-203`). Whole rendered entries are appended, not arbitrary UTF-8 byte slices. The bound is for stall notice plus PA line, not unrelated recipient FYIs additionally attached to a delivery. |
| Prior security boundaries | Stall previews remain fenced and identifiers rendered; the PA line contains no FYI bodies (`core/src/fyi_watch.rs:109-144,173-180`). Refresh remains limited to local-origin `pij-bg` notices (`220-238`). FYI reads remain bearer-protected and excluded from peer-key routes (`daemon/src/http/mod.rs:433-441,763-791,1992-2017`). C33's accepted local-key/full-body attribution semantics are unchanged. |

**S214-L001: deferred direct-typing retry can retain a stale PA line.** The direct attempt computes `direct`, frames its noted body, then enqueues that same attempted message if submission is deferred (`delivery/mod.rs:1136,1347-1349,1403-1408`). Suffix recognition preserves it on retry (`fyi_notes.rs:70-84`). Consequently, “the line is never stored” is not a universal guarantee.

PM confirmed this is intentional: retain exactly the staged text so plan 184's leftover recognition matches, rather than introduce the stall described by the correctness review's F003. The possible stale `Waiting FYIs:` line on that retried turn is a cosmetic Known limit, not a blocking security or normal-use stall finding. The ordinary-queue regression does not cover this exception. P214-N001 remains the separately named C34 performance follow-up.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | None identified in reviewed delta under C33 | - |

**CI proof:** clean detached worktree HEAD and GitHub/remote heads agree; GitHub reports CLEAN. Run [42747508415](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42747508415) checked merge `105709a87f44cccbf193a9a2be0a42c33e8eaba4`, whose parents are base `04c9e107b2f73497b4142c361bc1e6e0f5d28401` and this exact head. Rust reports **2,378 passed, 6 skipped**. Successful artifact `13731519016` includes `a_digests_full_read_marks_a_state_notice_it_left_out`, `a_queued_pa_turn_carries_the_line_as_of_its_hand_over`, and the delivered-stall-budget test, all passing. Node 22 reports 2,281 passed/6 skipped; native extension tests report 339 passed, zero failed. Latest delivers succeeds; its superseded cancelled run is not test proof.

Static source review and existing CI only. No local builds/tests, commands under review, product mutations, credential reads or live probes. Production display/timing was not independently exercised.
